ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
title: MBBS Seats Increase to 1.29 Lakh, PG Seats Nearly Triple to 86,360 Between AY 2023–24 and AY 2025–26
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

MBBS Seats Increase to 1.29 Lakh, PG Seats Nearly Triple to 86,360 Between AY 2023–24 and AY 2025–26

India's Doctor-Population Ratio Improves to 1:778 with Over 22.86 Lakh Registered Medical Practitioners

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
24 JUL 2026 3:51PM by PIB Delhi

As informed by the National Medical Commission (NMC), there is an increase in MBBS seats from 1,09,115 in AY 2023-24 to 1,28,976 in AY 2025-26 and an increase in PG seats from 31,185 in AY 2023-24 to 86,360 in AY 2025-26.

As per the Indian Medical Register (IMR), the total number of registered is 15,35,155 and 7,51,768 registered practitioners in the AYUSH system of medicine as of now. Assuming that 80% of registered practitioners in both the allopathic and AYUSH systems are available, the doctor-population ratio in the country is estimated to be 1:778.

The Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare,
Shri. Jagat Prakash Nadda
 stated this in a written reply in the Lok Sabha today.

*******
